name: sgrt
description: SGRT - Sistema de Gestión de Reportes Técnicos (monorepo frontend + backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
